rationale: C15 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Both letters distinguish between legislation that is unnecessary or impracticable under present circumstances and related longer-range legislation that Congress should continue pursuing. They also share unusually close transitional wording—“accordingly,” “not necessary ... at this time,” and “legislation of this character”—and move through the same sequence: prior support or request, changed circumstances, postponement of immediate action, and renewed support for later action. C08 has a similar defer-now/legislate-later structure, while C06 shares the Korean-emergency predicate but focuses on reducing an existing bill rather than postponing enactment while preserving the long-term objective.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Accordingly, it does not seem to me immediately necessary for the Congress to enact universal training legislation.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The emergency situation which was the basis of my request for seizure authority no longer exists, therefore, and, accordingly, it is not necessary for the Congress to give further consideration to such legislation at this time.
shared_material.explanation: Both use changed present circumstances to conclude that immediate congressional action on previously supported legislation is unnecessary.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Legislation of this character, however, should be placed on the statute books at an early date so that we can put it into operation as soon as circumstances permit.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The end of the coal strike has in no way diminished the need for a long-range study of the coal industry... I, therefore, hope that the Congress will enact legislation of this character as soon as possible.
shared_material.explanation: Each pivots from postponing one immediate legislative step to affirming the continuing need for longer-range legislation, using the same phrase “legislation of this character.”

shared_material.child_excerpt: Accordingly, I hope that your Committee will continue its active consideration of this legislation with a view to seeking final action on it in January.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Pursuant to this statement... I attach for the consideration of the Senate (House of Representatives) a draft of legislation to establish a commission on the coal industry.
shared_material.explanation: Both preserve congressional consideration of a longer-term measure after explaining why the immediate proposal cannot or need not proceed.
